No gradient, gloss, sheen, highlight, light center, color variation, or tint. The label 電子書籍を開く is centered in white Meiryo Regular 12px with 16px line height. Keep the button saturated and clear as a functional action; all other surfaces remain white.

Preserve the exact book-cover image from reference 4 with its existing crop, colors, title artwork and bookmark glyph. Do not redraw, retouch, recolor, stretch or replace it. Reference 3 is the original Fable screen for the same cover and action only; exclude all phone chrome, page header, member details, tabs and lobby content. Preserve all Japanese text exactly. Add no controls, badges, icons or extra copy. Keep the compact 390 by220 composition and align every element to the exact anchors above.
